# The workspace builds on nightly: the dev profile selects the Cranelift
# codegen backend and `.cargo/config.toml` enables the parallel rustc
# frontend (`-Zthreads`). Both are nightly-only build-speed features.
[toolchain]
channel = "nightly"
components = [
    "rustc-codegen-cranelift-preview",
    "rustfmt",
    "clippy",
    "llvm-tools",
    "rust-src",
]
---
# Parallel rustc frontend: parallelizes the front-end (parse/typeck/borrowck)
# of each crate, shortening the deep `kernel -> core -> engine -> run -> ...`
# critical path. Nightly-only; the repo pins nightly via `rust-toolchain.toml`.
[build]
rustflags = ["-Zthreads=8"]

[profile.release]
debug = "line-tables-only"

# Dev builds default to full debuginfo (=2), which is slow to emit and bloats
# target/. Line tables keep backtraces useful while cutting build time + size.
#
# Keep the default LLVM backend. Local measurement on the `leaven-run` test
# binaries showed no meaningful wall-time win from Cranelift, and the pinned
# nightly ICEs when Cranelift, incremental compilation, and the parallel rustc
# frontend are combined.
[profile.dev]
debug = "line-tables-only"

# Coverage profile: `scripts/coverage-gate.py` builds under `--profile coverage`.
[profile.coverage]
inherits = "dev"

[workspace.lints.rust]
unsafe_code = "forbid"
